title: License issuance production: vendor keypair management + signing-env integration (A3 packaging)
body: A2 implements asymmetric issue+verify (Ed25519) but issuance currently uses a dev keypair. Production needs a vendor keypair provisioned in the signing environment (never shipped), the public key packaged with the product, and integration with A3 compiled/signed packaging.
